title: Understanding AUC-ROC
text: The AUC-ROC curve is a graphical representation of a model's performance across different thresholds. It plots the true positive rate against the false positive rate. Consider how changing the threshold might affect these rates.

title: Threshold and Predictions
text: Changing the threshold affects which probabilities are classified as positive or negative. Think about how this might impact the true positive and false positive rates.

title: Effect of Threshold on AUC-ROC
text: Does changing the threshold alter the shape of the ROC curve?

title: True Positive and False Positive Rates
text: If you change the threshold, do the true positive and false positive rates change?
